equivalent_implementation_files.app.py:
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import sys


def main(argv: list[str]) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("name")
    parser.add_argument("--shout", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)

    message = "Hello, %s!" % args.name
    if args.shout:
        message = message.upper()
    print(message)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main(sys.argv[1:]))

from __future__ import annotations

from decimal import Decimal
import sys


def main(argv: list[str]) -> int:
    customer = argv[0]
    amount = Decimal(argv[1])
    large = amount >= Decimal("100")
    rates = {
        ("regular", False): Decimal("1.00"),
        ("regular", True): Decimal("0.95"),
        ("member", False): Decimal("0.90"),
        ("member", True): Decimal("0.85"),
    }
    print(f"{amount * rates[(customer, large)]:.2f}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main(sys.argv[1:]))
